Track 1: Getting Started

PEPPOL 5-Corner Model

Traditional PEPPOL networks use a 4-corner model (Seller → AP1 → AP2 → Buyer). The UAE introduces a **5-Corner Model**, integrating the Federal Tax Authority (FTA) directly into the network.

Active Node Detail

Corner 1 (C1)

The entity generating the invoice. C1 integrates their ERP or accounting system with an accredited Access Point to send business documents.

Technical Functions:

  • •Extracts invoice details from ERP database
  • •Transforms data into PEPPOL PINT AE XML (UBL)
  • •Constructs the Standard Business Document Header (SBDH)
  • •Sends payload via API/Secure channel to Corner 2

Architecture Comparison

FeatureStandard 4-Corner ModelUAE 5-Corner Model
Tax Authority IntegrationAuthority is offline or receives reports in batch mode later.Real-time reporting. Corner 5 (FTA) audits the invoice on transmit.
Validation EngineAccess Points only validate schemas.Double validation at AP levels and central FTA schema auditing.
Network DecouplingSeller & buyer must coordinate access point protocols.Standards are enforced nationally, simplifying ERP onboarding.
